name: Futanari Shoujo Kinryouku ~Ijou Seiyoku Kankin Gakuen~
original_name: ふたなり少女禁猟区～異常性欲監禁学園～
source:
The main character, Naomi, made her dream comes true and started working as a teacher in an isolated school in the mountains.

However, she noticed an abnormality in the school.
She found two girls petting together in the classroom, and they had something between their legs which they were not supposed to have.
They panted and ejaculated the white liquid.

Naomi was confused with what she saw.
And the encounter with a girl lead her to further abnormality...

In the crazy world, Naomi finds out the secret of the school.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE047665.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
主角娜奥米实现了自己的梦想，开始在山区一所偏僻的学校当老师。

然而，她却发现学校里出现了异常。
她发现两个女孩在教室里互相爱抚，她们的双腿之间夹着一些不应该有的东西。
他们气喘吁吁地射出白色液体。

内奥米对她所看到的感到困惑。
而与女孩的邂逅，让她更加变态……

在疯狂的世界里，娜奥米发现了学校的秘密。
